verdict.rationale: stagewise offers a skills-and-plugins system: plugins expose slash commands in chat and include integrations for third-party services such as GitHub, Supabase, and Figma. These are integrations of partner services into the stagewise agent, not evidence that partner-built agent apps can be installed or run in stagewise workflows. Missing for 10: evidence that plugins are partner-built or that a third-party developer/partner program exists, a marketplace or distribution mechanism for external agent apps, a way to run third-party agents (rather than tools for stagewise's own agent), and independent corroboration.
